name: Damper Actuator
summary: 공개 통합 포인트 리스트에서 자동 추출했다. BACnet 21점

points.name: RelPos
points.note: Relative Position in % Overridden = true, if the gear is disengaged

points.name: AbsPos
points.note: Absolute Position in degree or mm The unit depends on the device: [°] for actuators with rotary movement [mm] for actuators with linear movement Overridden = true, if the gear is disengaged

points.name: SpAnalog
points.note: Analog Setpoint in % Shows the setpoint in % if actuator is control by analog signal (SpSource MV[122] is analog(1)) If SpSource MV[122] is Bus(2) then Out Of Service is TRUE _ _

points.name: Sens1Analog
points.note: Sensor 1 as analog value in V / Ω / – / °C / °F Current value of sensor 1 in case Sensor1Type MV[220] is Active If Sens1Type MV[220] is not Active(2) or SpSource MV[122] is Analog(1) then Out Of Service is TRUE _ _

points.name: Sens2Analog
points.note: Sensor 2 as analog value in V / Ω / – / °C / °F Current value of sensor 2 in case Sensor2 Type MV[221] is Active(2) If Sens2 Type MV[221] is not Active(2) or SpSource MV[122] is Analog(1) then Out Of Service is TRUE _ _

points.name: SpRel
points.note: Relative Setpoint in % Setpoint for actuator between 0 and Max AV[98] if controlled via bus If SpSource MV[122] is Analog(1) then Out Of Service is TRUE _ _

points.name: Min
points.note: Min Setpoint in % Min has to be ≤ Max -30%

points.name: Max
points.note: Max Setpoint in % Max has to be ≥ Min +30%

points.name: Bus Watchdog
points.note: Timeout for Bus Watchdog in s 0 = watchdog deactivated If the Present Value is not ZERO, the implementation tracks write _ procedures to Present Value of AO[1] and MO[1] _ If the Present Value of AO[1] or MO[1] is written, the timer is rese

points.name: Sens1Switch
points.note: _ Sensor 1 as Switch Indicates value on sensor 1 in case Sensor1Type MV[220] is Switch(5) If Sens1Type MV[220] is not Switch(5) or SpSource MV[122] is Analog(1) then Out Of Service is TRUE _ _

points.name: Sens2Switch
points.note: Sensor 2 as Switch Indicates value on sensor 1 in case Sensor2Type MV[221] is Switch(5) If Sens2Type MV[221] is not Switch(5) or SpSource MV[122] is Analog(1) then Out Of Service is TRUE _ _

points.name: BusTermination
points.note: Bus Termination Indicates if bus termination (120 Ω) is enabled. Bus termination can be set with the configuration tools.

points.name: SummaryStatus
points.note: Summary Status Summary of all Status (MI[106], MI[110])

points.name: InternalActivity
points.note: _ Internal Activity Test: Internal test running, activated by bus

points.name: StatusActuator
points.note: Status Actuator Actuator cannot move: Mechanical overload e.g. blocked actuator, etc. Gear disengaged: Button is pressed Mechanical travel increased: The actuator has been moved outside the adapted working range

points.name: StatusDevice
points.note: Status Device Indicates general status about the device Bus Watchdog triggered: Timeout for Bus Watchdog expired

points.name: Override
points.note: Override Control Override the setpoint (SpRel AO[1] or analog signal) with defined values

points.name: Command
points.note: Initiate Function Initiation of actuator functions for service and test. After command is sent, value returns to None(1). With Reset(4) all status in StatusActuator MI[106] can be reset

points.name: SpSource
points.note: Setpoint Source If Analog(1) then actuator is controlled by analog signal 0...10 V on wire 3. If Bus(2) then setpoint via bus SpRel AO[1]

points.name: Sens1Type
points.note: Sensor 1 Type If SpSource MV[122] is Analog(1) then Out Of Service is TRUE _ _

points.name: Sens2Type
points.note: Sensor 2 Type If SpSource MV[122] is Analog(1) then Out Of Service is TRUE _ _
